role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 随着战斗的推进，小小的身材和力量都将成长到惊人的地步，而他的威力也会非常可怕。他向敌人们投掷英雄，或者让他们在山崩下昏迷。只要给他机会发挥出完全的实力，他就能摧枯拉朽般毁灭敌方的基地。
hero_summary_en: Growing to tremendous size and strength as the battle progresses, Tiny's power can quickly become terrifying. He tosses heroes and creeps at his enemies, or stuns them beneath an avalanche. Should he gather his full strength, he can demolish the enemy's base with ease.

abilities.name: tiny_avalanche
abilities.description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

abilities.name: tiny_toss
abilities.description_zh: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
notes_zh: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
notes_en: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_grab
abilities.description_zh: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
notes_zh: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。
notes_en: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_channel
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

abilities.name: tiny_insurmountable
abilities.description_zh: 小小从力量中获得状态和减速抗性。减速抗性还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
abilities.description_en: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_zh: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。
notes_en: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: tiny_grow
abilities.description_zh: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
abilities.description_en: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

shard_loc.en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
shard_loc.zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

abilities.name: tiny_toss_tree
abilities.description_zh: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
abilities.description_en: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_tiny_5
talents_raw.desc_loc: Toss can target the ground as well as enemy units.
